About the job
Kranichhaus is an online retailer for home and living with 2.4 million active customers in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Our customer service handles about 180,000 contacts a month across phone, e-mail, chat and WhatsApp, with an in-house team of 70 in Berlin and a BPO partner in Lisbon with 110 agents.

After strong growth our service quality has slipped: CSAT dropped from 86 to 74 percent and the e-mail backlog reaches five days. We are looking for an experienced Interim Head of Customer Service for six to nine months.

What you will do
• Lead the customer service organisation (in-house team, team leads, workforce planning, quality) and steer the BPO partner
• Bring backlogs and service levels back on track within the first 90 days
• Rework our omnichannel set-up in Zendesk, including routing, macros and self-service in the help center
• Introduce a KPI framework (CSAT, FCR, AHT, contact rate) and weekly reviews with the BPO
• Prepare the decision on a chatbot with generative AI for order status and returns
• Hire and onboard a permanent Head of Customer Service together with HR

What you bring
• 10+ years in customer service leadership, ideally in e-commerce or retail
• Proven experience with outsourcing partners and multi-site set-ups
• Hands-on knowledge of Zendesk or a comparable ticketing system
• Fluent English, German is a strong plus

Terms
• Start: as soon as possible, at the latest 15.11.2026
• Duration: 6 months, extension possible
• On site in Berlin two to three days a week, travel to Lisbon about once a month
• Day rate €1,100 to €1,250
